# meta-ads-mcp

> MCP server for the Meta Marketing API v26.0 — 134 tools for managing Facebook & Instagram ad campaigns, audiences, creatives, insights, catalogs, and more.

## Install

Requires Node.js 20 or later, including the MCP host's runtime.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "meta-ads": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@mikusnuz/meta-ads-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "META_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN": "your-access-token",
        "META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID": "123456789",
        "META_APP_ID": "your-app-id",
        "META_APP_SECRET": "your-app-secret",
        "META_BUSINESS_ID": "your-business-id",
        "META_PIXEL_ID": "your-pixel-id"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Environment Variables

- META_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN (required): Meta Marketing API access token
- META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID (required): Ad account ID (numeric, without act_ prefix)
- META_APP_ID (optional): App ID for token exchange/extension and debug
- META_APP_SECRET (optional): App secret for token exchange/extension and debug
- META_BUSINESS_ID (optional): Business Manager ID for business tools
- META_PIXEL_ID (optional): Pixel ID for conversion tools

## Tools (134)

Ad-set launch options: create_adset supports bid_amount. Both create_adset and update_adset accept dsa_beneficiary/dsa_payor, destination_type, attribution_spec, adset_schedule, pacing_type, and validate_only. Set validate_only=true explicitly for non-mutating Meta validation; defaults preserve normal writes. Schedules require effective lifetime budgeting; Meta validates campaign/objective restrictions. No automatic budget or status conversion. USER is the API's default schedule timezone; use ADVERTISER explicitly for account-local hours. DSA payer and beneficiary use independent account defaults, not each other's values.

create_custom_audience accepts rule (JSON object), pixel_id, and retention_days. It creates an audience; no validate-only guarantee is offered.

### Campaign Management (26)
list_campaigns, get_campaign, create_campaign, update_campaign, delete_campaign, copy_campaign, get_campaign_adsets, get_campaign_ads, get_campaign_leads, list_adsets, get_adset, create_adset, update_adset, delete_adset, copy_adset, get_adset_ads, get_adset_leads, get_adset_targeting_sentence, list_ads, get_ad, create_ad, update_ad, delete_ad, copy_ad, get_ad_preview, get_delivery_estimate

copy_campaign, copy_adset, and copy_ad duplicate existing objects. get_adset_targeting_sentence returns a readable description of an ad set's targeting.

### Creatives (6)
list_creatives, get_creative, create_creative, update_creative, create_dynamic_creative, generate_preview

generate_preview renders a preview from a creative specification without requiring an existing ad.

### Media Assets (12)
list_images, upload_image, get_image, delete_image, list_videos, upload_video, get_video, delete_video, list_canvases, get_canvas, create_canvas, delete_canvas

### Audiences & Targeting (16)
list_custom_audiences, get_audience, create_custom_audience, update_audience, delete_audience, add_users_to_audience, remove_users_from_audience, create_lookalike_audience, get_audience_health, list_saved_audiences, get_saved_audience, search_targeting, search_locations, search_targeting_map, get_reach_estimate, get_targeting_suggestions

get_audience_health checks a custom audience's size, operation status, and delivery readiness.

### Insights & Reporting (6)
get_account_insights, get_campaign_insights, get_adset_insights, get_ad_insights, create_async_report, get_async_report

### Leads (5)
get_form_leads, get_lead, list_lead_forms, get_lead_form, create_lead_form

create_lead_form creates a Facebook Page lead form and requires pages_manage_ads permission.

### Catalog & Commerce (17)
list_catalogs, get_catalog, create_catalog, update_catalog, list_product_sets, create_product_set, get_product_set, update_product_set, list_products, get_product, update_product, batch_products, get_batch_status, list_feeds, create_feed, upload_feed, get_feed_uploads

batch_products submits catalog product creates, updates, or deletes in a batch. get_batch_status checks the resulting operation.

### Automation & Rules (5)
list_rules, get_rule, create_rule, update_rule, delete_rule

### Experiments (5)
list_experiments, create_experiment, get_experiment, update_experiment, get_experiment_results

### Conversions (4)
send_conversion_event, send_offline_event, list_offline_event_sets, create_offline_event_set

### Budget & Planning (8)
list_budget_schedules, create_budget_schedule, update_budget_schedule, delete_budget_schedule, list_rf_predictions, create_rf_prediction, get_rf_prediction, delete_rf_prediction

### Brand Safety (5)
list_block_lists, create_block_list, add_to_block_list, remove_from_block_list, delete_block_list

### Account & Business (15)
get_ad_account, list_ad_accounts, update_ad_account, get_account_activities, list_account_users, list_businesses, get_business, list_business_ad_accounts, list_business_pages, list_business_instagram_accounts, list_business_users, add_business_user, remove_business_user, list_system_users, create_system_user

list_business_pages and list_business_instagram_accounts list assets owned by the configured META_BUSINESS_ID.

### Auth & Token (3)
exchange_token, refresh_token, debug_token

### Ad Library (1)
search_ad_library

## Resources (3)
- ads://account — Ad account overview (status, balance, currency, timezone, total spend)
- ads://campaigns-overview — All active campaigns with budget information
- ads://spending-today — Today's spending summary (spend, impressions, clicks, reach)

## Prompts (3)
- campaign_wizard — Step-by-step guide to create a full ad campaign
- performance_report — Analyze ad performance with breakdowns and recommendations
- audience_builder — Build and refine target audiences

## Permissions Required
- ads_management: All campaign/ad set/ad/creative CRUD
- ads_read: All read/list operations and insights
- business_management: Business tools, system users, account assignments
- leads_retrieval: Lead form and lead data tools
- catalog_management: Catalog, product set, product, feed tools
- pages_read_engagement: Lead forms linked to pages
